_about: C-31: item id -> our name and description, from src/data/items.json.

1.name: ROOTBOX
1.description: A host with unrestricted rights. No daemon can decline to run on it. Nothing is refused root.

2.name: SUPERBOX
2.description: A host with elevated rights. Most daemons will run on it, including reluctant ones.

3.name: ADMINBOX
3.description: A host with wider rights than a USERBOX. More daemons will agree to run on it.

4.name: USERBOX
4.description: A host offered at user level. A steady daemon will run on it. A stubborn one will not.

5.name: GUESTBOX
5.description: A temporary host, issued at the gate and expiring at the gate. Its rights are minimal.

6.name: NET BOX
6.description: A somewhat different BOX that works especially well on WATER- and SWARM-type DAEMON.

7.name: DESCEND BOX
7.description: A somewhat different BOX that works especially well on DAEMON deep in the sea.

8.name: NEST BOX
8.description: A somewhat different BOX that works especially well on weaker DAEMON.

9.name: REPEAT BOX
9.description: A somewhat different BOX that works especially well on DAEMON bound before.

10.name: TIMER BOX
10.description: A somewhat different BOX that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

11.name: LUXURY BOX
11.description: A comfortable BOX that makes a captured wild DAEMON quickly grow friendly.

12.name: PREMIER BOX
12.description: A rare BOX that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

13.name: RECOVER
13.description: Puts back a little of what was lost. Restores 20 HP.

14.name: PATCH
14.description: A patch stops a leak at its source. Ends LEAKING, and the worse CASCADING with it.

15.name: COOLANT
15.description: Draws off the heat a daemon made itself. Ends OVERHEATED.

16.name: WATCHDOG
16.description: A watchdog notices a process that stopped answering, and resets it. Ends HUNG.

17.name: RESUME
17.description: Puts a SUSPENDED daemon back on the schedule. It was never gone, only unscheduled.

18.name: PRIORITY
18.description: Scheduled ahead of whatever was starving it. Ends THROTTLED.

19.name: SNAPSHOT
19.description: Restores a DAEMON whole: health and state together.

20.name: REBUILD
20.description: From nothing, rather than from where it got to. Restores all HP.

21.name: FULL RECOVER
21.description: Everything reachable, put back. Restores 200 HP.

22.name: DEEP RECOVER
22.description: Goes further in than the first one does. Restores 50 HP.

23.name: ROLLBACK
23.description: Rolls back to a known-good state. Ends every state at once, whatever it was.

24.name: RESTART
24.description: Starts a HALTED daemon again with half its health. It does not remember stopping.

25.name: REBOOT
25.description: Brings back a HALTED daemon at full health.

26.name: FRESH WATER
26.description: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one DAEMON by 50 points.

27.name: SODA POP
27.description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one DAEMON by 60 points.

28.name: LEMONADE
28.description: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one DAEMON by 80 points.

29.name: MOOMOO MILK
29.description: Highly nutritious milk. It restores the HP of one DAEMON by 100 points.

30.name: FIELD PATCH
30.description: Applied where it broke, by whoever was standing there. Restores 50 HP.

31.name: WORKAROUND
31.description: Not the fix. The thing you do instead of the fix, and it works. Restores 200 HP.

32.name: HOTFIX
32.description: Bitter, cheap, and it works now. Clears every state.

33.name: COLD START
33.description: Brought up from nothing rather than resumed. Restarts a HALTED daemon at full health.

34.name: CHARGE
34.description: Puts the budget back for one routine. Restores 10 MP.

35.name: FULL CHARGE
35.description: One routine, all of its budget. Restores that routine's MP.

36.name: CHARGE ALL
36.description: Every routine at once, a little each. Restores 10 MP to all.

37.name: FULL RECHARGE
37.description: Every routine, all of it. Restores the MP of every one.

38.name: LAVA COOKIE
38.description: LAVARIDGE TOWN's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one DAEMON.

39.name: WAKE TONE
39.description: A tone that reaches something not scheduled. Ends SUSPENDED.

40.name: CALM TONE
40.description: A tone steady enough to work against. Ends THRASHING.

41.name: CLEAR TONE
41.description: A tone that cuts through a binding made without asking.

42.name: LOW TONE
42.description: Pitched under what wild daemons answer to. Fewer appear.

43.name: HIGH TONE
43.description: Pitched where wild daemons answer. More appear.

44.name: RESERVE
44.description: Held back for the moment it is needed. Restores 20 HP.

45.name: RESTART ALL
45.description: Every halted daemon at once, and all of them whole.

46.name: SHOAL SALT
46.description: Pure salt obtained from deep inside the SHOAL CAVE. It is extremely salty.

47.name: SHOAL SHELL
47.description: A pretty seashell found deep inside the SHOAL CAVE. It is striped in blue and white.

48.name: RED SHARD
48.description: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

49.name: BLUE SHARD
49.description: A small blue shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

50.name: YELLOW SHARD
50.description: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

51.name: GREEN SHARD
51.description: A small green shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.

63.name: MEMORY
63.description: How much a daemon can hold before it stops. Raises base HP.

64.name: WATTAGE
64.description: How hard it can drive something. Raises base ATTACK.

65.name: SHIELDING
65.description: What sits between it and what is arriving. Raises base DEFENSE.

66.name: CLOCK RATE
66.description: How many times a second it gets to act. Raises base SPEED.

67.name: BANDWIDTH
67.description: How much it can push down one channel. Raises base SP. ATK.

68.name: INCREMENT
68.description: Adds exactly one, which is what the word means. Raises the level.

69.name: MP UP
69.description: Slightly raises the maximum MP of a selected ROUTINE for one DAEMON.

70.name: INSULATION
70.description: What keeps the outside out. Raises base SP. DEF.

71.name: MP MAX
71.description: Raises the MP of a selected ROUTINE to its maximum level for one DAEMON.

73.name: LOCK STATS
73.description: Nothing outside gets to change them. Blocks stat reduction for five turns.

74.name: TUNE CRIT
74.description: Reaches further into the tail of the distribution. Raises the critical-hit ratio in battle.

75.name: TUNE ATTACK
75.description: Turned up for this engagement only. Raises ATTACK in battle.

76.name: TUNE DEFENSE
76.description: Turned up for this engagement only. Raises DEFENSE in battle.

77.name: TUNE SPEED
77.description: Turned up for this engagement only. Raises SPEED in battle.

78.name: TUNE AIM
78.description: Turned up for this engagement only. Raises accuracy in battle.

79.name: TUNE SP. ATK
79.description: Turned up for this engagement only. Raises SP. ATK in battle.

80.name: DECOY
80.description: Something else to attend to. Lets you DETACH from any wild daemon.

81.name: FLUFFY TAIL
81.description: An attractive item. Use it to DETACH from any battle with a wild DAEMON.

85.name: EJECT
85.description: Out, now, from wherever you are. Returns you to the last CHECKPOINT you used.

86.name: SUPPRESS
86.description: Holds the channel quiet. Weak wild daemons stay away for 100 steps.

93.name: EXPOSURE
93.description: Simply being left in front of something, for long enough. Some daemons take a new form.

94.name: REFLECTION
94.description: Light that came back, and the other meaning. Some daemons take a new form when given one.

95.name: AXIOM
95.description: Something for a mind to reason from. Some daemons take a new form when given one.

96.name: EMBEDDING
96.description: A representation a mind can search through. Some daemons take a new form when given one.

97.name: AFFECT
97.description: Something for a mind to feel with. Some daemons take a new form when given one.

98.name: REWARD
98.description: A signal a mind can learn from. Some daemons take a new form when given one.

103.name: TINYMUSHROOM
103.description: A small and rare mushroom. It is quite popular among certain people.

104.name: BIG MUSHROOM
104.description: A large and rare mushroom. It is very popular among certain people.

106.name: PEARL
106.description: A relatively small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply.

107.name: BIG PEARL
107.description: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price.

108.name: STARDUST
108.description: A pretty red sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price.

109.name: STAR PIECE
109.description: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price.

110.name: NUGGET
110.description: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price.

111.name: HEART SCALE
111.description: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. It glows faintly in the colors of a rainbow.

121.name: ORANGE MAIL
121.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute DETOUR print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

122.name: HARBOR MAIL
122.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute TANGENT print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

123.name: GLITTER MAIL
123.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute SPIKE print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

124.name: MECH MAIL
124.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute SENTINEL print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

125.name: WOOD MAIL
125.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute DAYDREAM print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

126.name: WAVE MAIL
126.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute DOLPHIN print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

127.name: BEAD MAIL
127.description: A piece of MAIL to be held by a DAEMON. It will bear the print of the DAEMON holding it.

128.name: SHADOW MAIL
128.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute FADING print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

129.name: TROPIC MAIL
129.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute GOLDSET print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

130.name: DREAM MAIL
130.description: A piece of MAIL to be held by a DAEMON. It will bear the print of the DAEMON holding it.

131.name: FAB MAIL
131.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a gorgeous, extravagant print. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

132.name: RETRO MAIL
132.description: A piece of MAIL featuring a print of three cute DAEMON. It is to be held by a DAEMON.

133.name: THROTTLE TRAP
133.description: Armed against one condition and spent on it. Ends THROTTLED, once.

134.name: SUSPEND TRAP
134.description: Fires the moment the daemon stops being scheduled. Ends SUSPENDED, once.

135.name: LEAK TRAP
135.description: Catches a slow loss before it compounds. Ends LEAKING, once.

136.name: HEAT TRAP
136.description: Fires on heat the daemon made itself. Ends OVERHEATED, once.

137.name: HANG TRAP
137.description: Fires when nothing else will. Ends HUNG, once.

138.name: EXHAUST TRAP
138.description: Fires when a routine runs out of budget. Restores 10 MP, once.

139.name: LOW MARK
139.description: The level at which something is done about it. Restores 10 HP when health falls, once.

140.name: THRASH TRAP
140.description: Catches a daemon making no progress against itself. Ends THRASHING, once.

141.name: CATCH ALL
141.description: The handler that takes whatever arrives. Ends any state, once.

142.name: HIGH MARK
142.description: The same idea, set higher and worth more. Restores 30 HP when health falls, once.

143.name: SPICY TRAP
143.description: Restores health, and may leave a daemon THRASHING. Which is which depends on the daemon.

144.name: DRY TRAP
144.description: Restores health, and may leave a daemon THRASHING. Which is which depends on the daemon.

145.name: SWEET TRAP
145.description: Restores health, and may leave a daemon THRASHING. Which is which depends on the daemon.

146.name: BITTER TRAP
146.description: Restores health, and may leave a daemon THRASHING. Which is which depends on the daemon.

147.name: SOUR TRAP
147.description: Restores health, and may leave a daemon THRASHING. Which is which depends on the daemon.

148.name: RAZZ BERRY
148.description: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

167.description: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

168.name: AUTO ATTACK
168.description: Turns itself up when there is little left. Raises ATTACK in a pinch.

169.name: AUTO DEFENSE
169.description: Turns itself up when there is little left. Raises DEFENSE in a pinch.

170.name: AUTO SPEED
170.description: Turns itself up when there is little left. Raises SPEED in a pinch.

171.name: AUTO SP. ATK
171.description: Turns itself up when there is little left. Raises SP. ATK in a pinch.

172.name: AUTO SP. DEF
172.description: Turns itself up when there is little left. Raises SP. DEF in a pinch.

173.name: AUTO CRIT
173.description: Reaches further into the tail when there is little left. Raises the critical-hit ratio.

174.name: AUTO ANY
174.description: Turns one of them sharply up, and does not say which. Raises a random stat in a pinch.

175.name: ENIGMA BERRY
175.description: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.

179.name: DITHER
179.description: Noise added on purpose, so that nothing can be pinned exactly. Their aim slips.

180.name: REVERT
180.description: Puts a value back the way it was. Restores a lowered stat, once.

181.name: DEBUG BUILD
181.description: Every step is instrumented, so it learns faster and runs slower. SPEED falls.

182.name: WEIGHT SHARE
182.description: Two things trained as one: what teaches the first teaches the second. Shares EXP. POINTS.

183.name: QUEUE JUMP
183.description: Sometimes the scheduler takes you out of turn. The holder may move first.

184.name: AFFINITY
184.description: Affinity binds a process to one host. The holder grows attached faster.

185.name: UNPAIR
185.description: Drops a binding that was formed without being asked for. Works once.

186.name: HARD CODED
186.description: One value, written in, with no way to pass another. Powers up one routine and allows no other.

187.name: BUBBLE
187.description: A gap pushed into a pipeline where nothing issues. They may flinch.

188.name: SWARM GAIN
188.description: Many small agents; no single one matters. Gain lifts one channel: this one is SWARM.

189.name: SURCHARGE
189.description: Charged on top of the agreed rate. Doubles prize money if the holder took part.

190.name: MUTE
190.description: Mutes the channel wild daemons listen on. Carried in front, fewer of them approach.

191.name: INNER STATE
191.description: An orb for CASTOR or POLYDEUCES. What it holds, nothing outside can read. Raises both SP. stats.

192.name: DEEP FEATURE
192.description: A representation learned far from the surface. It raises the SP. ATK stat.

193.name: DEEP LAYER
193.description: The layers nothing outside gets at directly. It raises the SP. DEF stat.

194.name: ESCAPE HATCH
194.description: A way out that is always open. The holder can DETACH from any wild daemon.

195.name: VERSION LOCK
195.description: Pins a thing to the version it is at. The holder will not evolve.

196.name: FAILSAFE
196.description: What stops the fall when everything else already has. The holder may survive on 1 HP.

197.name: LEARNING RATE
197.description: How large a step each lesson takes. Turned up: the holder earns more EXP. POINTS.

198.name: LONG TAIL
198.description: The far end of a distribution, where the rare large values are. Raises the critical-hit ratio.

199.name: HARDENED GAIN
199.description: Hardened against whatever anyone tries. Gain lifts one channel: this one is HARDENED.

200.name: HEADROOM
200.description: The margin left before anything clips. The holder recovers a little each turn.

201.name: SCALING LAW
201.description: What happens to a thing when you only make it bigger. A BACKPRESS may be holding it.

202.name: SUPPLY RAIL
202.description: The line every other part draws from. Held by a SPIKE, it raises the SP. ATK stat.

203.name: STRATUM GAIN
203.description: The layer everything else runs on. Gain lifts one channel: this one is STRATUM.

204.name: LEGACY GAIN
204.description: Old material everything else has had time to work on. Gain lifts one channel: this one is LEGACY.

205.name: GROWTH GAIN
205.description: Training: fitting to whatever it is fed. Gain lifts one channel: this one is GROWTH.

206.name: OPAQUE GAIN
206.description: The black box, from outside. Gain lifts one channel: this one is OPAQUE.

207.name: LOGIC GAIN
207.description: Rules applied step by step, not intuition. Gain lifts one channel: this one is LOGIC.

208.name: SIGNAL GAIN
208.description: Raw current, before anything interprets it. Gain lifts one channel: this one is SIGNAL.

209.name: FLOW GAIN
209.description: Everything running downhill to the lowest point. Gain lifts one channel: this one is FLOW.

210.name: VECTOR GAIN
210.description: A direction that never touches the ground. Gain lifts one channel: this one is VECTOR.

211.name: CORRUPT GAIN
211.description: Data that has been tampered with. Gain lifts one channel: this one is CORRUPT.

212.name: FROZEN GAIN
212.description: Locked to what it already saw. Gain lifts one channel: this one is FROZEN.

213.name: LATENT GAIN
213.description: Running below the surface, unobserved. Gain lifts one channel: this one is LATENT.

214.name: CONTEXT GAIN
214.description: The frame you read a thing in. Gain lifts one channel: this one is CONTEXT.

215.name: ENTROPY GAIN
215.description: Noise and heat; disorder that spreads. Gain lifts one channel: this one is ENTROPY.

216.name: EMERGENT GAIN
216.description: Behaviour nobody designed and nobody can account for. Gain lifts the EMERGENT channel.

217.name: CONTENT GAIN
217.description: The thing itself, with nothing read into it. Gain lifts one channel: this one is CONTENT.

218.name: SERVICE PACK
218.description: Everything that was fixed since the release, in one bundle. Made by FOUNDRY CO.

219.name: RECLAIM
219.description: Takes back what is no longer in use. The holder recovers HP on striking.

220.name: FLOW TRIM
220.description: A trim is a small gain. This one lifts the FLOW channel a little.

221.name: DITHER TRIM
221.description: Dither, at a lower setting. Their aim slips a little.

222.name: FLUKE
222.description: A result nothing predicted and nothing repeats. It raises UPTIME's critical-hit ratio.

223.name: STRICT MODE
223.description: Refuses anything it was not promised. It raises MOCK's DEFENSE stat.

224.name: BARE METAL
224.description: Nothing at all between you and the hardware. It raises ARTEFACT's and COREFILE's ATTACK.

225.name: OFF BY ONE
225.description: The error at the edge that everything else survives. Raises EDGECASE's critical-hit ratio.

226.name: TEXTBOOK
226.description: Every board in CALLOW SCHOOL, for reading anywhere: one chapter to a floor, one topic to a page.

227.name: DIPLOMA
227.description: CALLOW SCHOOL's, for the paper passed. THE READING ROOM in BRAZEN asks to see one.

228.name: GUIDE
228.description: THE PROGRAMMER'S GUIDE TO THE HUMAN MIND. From a bookshelf on ONE ISLAND.

254.name: RED SCARF
254.description: An item to be held by a DAEMON. It boosts the holding DAEMON's COOL condition in CONTESTS.

255.name: BLUE SCARF
255.description: An item to be held by a DAEMON. It boosts the holding DAEMON's STYLIST condition in CONTESTS.

256.name: PINK SCARF
256.description: An item to be held by a DAEMON. It boosts the holding DAEMON's CUTE condition in CONTESTS.

257.name: GREEN SCARF
257.description: An item to be held by a DAEMON. It boosts the holding DAEMON's SMART condition in CONTESTS.

258.name: YELLOW SCARF
258.description: An item to be held by a DAEMON. It boosts the holding DAEMON's TOUGH condition in CONTESTS.

259.name: MACH BIKE
259.description: A folding bicycle that is at least twice as fast as walking.

260.name: TOKEN CASE
260.description: Holds the tokens the GAME CORNER deals in. It holds up to 9,999.

261.name: GREP
261.description: Finds the thing that is there and not shown. Reports a hidden item nearby.

262.name: QUERY
262.description: Asks a body of water what is in it. The answers are shallow.

263.name: DEEP QUERY
263.description: Asks the same question further down.

264.name: FULL SCAN
264.description: Reads the whole of it rather than asking. Slow, and it finds everything.

265.name: S.S. TICKET
265.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. ANNE. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

266.name: CONTEST PASS
266.description: The pass required for entering DAEMON CONTESTS. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

267.name: NOTEBOOK
267.description: For writing down what happened, in the order it is found. CAIRN gave it to you.

268.name: WAILMER PAIL
268.description: A nifty watering pail. Use it to promote strong growth in BERRIES planted in soft soil.

269.name: PEER REVIEW
269.description: Signed and sealed. Addressed to everyone who signed the first one.

270.name: SOOT SACK
270.description: A sack used to collect volcanic ash automatically during walks over deep ash.

271.name: BASEMENT KEY
271.description: The key to NEW MAUVILLE, which was constructed beneath MAUVILLE CITY.

272.name: ACRO BIKE
272.description: A folding bicycle that is capable of stunts like jumps and wheelies.

273.name: {POKEBLOCK} CASE
273.description: A case for holding {POKEBLOCK}S made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one {POKEBLOCK} when shaken.

274.name: ENVELOPE
274.description: Sealed. It is addressed, and it is not addressed to you.

275.name: EON TICKET
275.description: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to a distant southern island. It features a drawing of an island.

276.name: RED ORB
276.description: An orb that glows red. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

277.name: BLUE ORB
277.description: An orb that glows blue. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

278.name: SCANNER
278.description: A device used to search for life-forms in water. It looks too difficult to use.

279.name: GO-GOGGLES
279.description: A pair of protective goggles. They enable a USER to travel through even desert sandstorms.

280.name: METEORITE
280.description: A meteorite that fell from space onto DEADSTACK long ago. It is very lumpy and hard.

281.name: RM. 1 KEY
281.description: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

282.name: RM. 2 KEY
282.description: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

283.name: RM. 4 KEY
283.description: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

284.name: RM. 6 KEY
284.description: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

285.name: STORAGE KEY
285.description: A key that opens the storage hold inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

286.name: ROOT FOSSIL
286.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling DAEMON. It appears to be part of a plant root.

287.name: CLAW FOSSIL
287.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling DAEMON. It appears to be part of a claw.

288.name: DEVON SCOPE
288.description: A scope that signals the presence of any unseeable DAEMON. It is made by the DEVON CORP.

289.name: PLUGIN01
289.description: Runs last, and only if nothing has interrupted the user first.

291.name: PLUGIN03
291.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also thrash them.

292.name: PLUGIN04
292.description: Settles the frame. Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF.

293.name: PLUGIN05
293.description: Forces them out and an ally in. In the wild, the battle ends.

294.name: PLUGIN06
294.description: Leaves them CASCADING, and the loss grows with every turn.

295.name: PLUGIN07
295.description: Small damage to all of them, every turn, for five turns.

296.name: PLUGIN08
296.description: Holds for more than one case. Raises ATTACK and DEFENSE.

297.name: PLUGIN09
297.description: Two to five small passes rather than one large one.

298.name: PLUGIN10
298.description: Its type and force are set by traits the user was made with, never shown.

299.name: PLUGIN11
299.description: Runs everything hot for five turns.

300.name: PLUGIN12
300.description: They can only attack for two turns. Nothing else.

301.name: PLUGIN13
301.description: Stops the weights updating. They may end up HUNG.

302.name: PLUGIN14
302.description: Everything stops updating at once. May leave them HUNG.

303.name: PLUGIN15
303.description: Commits everything in one write. The user must idle on the next turn.

304.name: PLUGIN16
304.description: Reads every incoming claim in its strongest form, for five turns.

305.name: PLUGIN17
305.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

306.name: PLUGIN18
306.description: Everything runs wetter for five turns.

307.name: PLUGIN19
307.description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

308.name: PLUGIN20
308.description: It protects the user's party from all status problems for five turns.

309.name: PLUGIN21
309.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its USER.

310.name: PLUGIN22
310.description: Gathers on the first turn, then runs it all at once on the second.

311.name: PLUGIN23
311.description: Load applied over and over until the armour gives. Their DEFENSE may drop.

312.name: PLUGIN24
312.description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave them throttled.

313.name: PLUGIN25
313.description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave them throttled.

314.name: PLUGIN26
314.description: The ground everything stands on moves. Hits all around it.

315.name: PLUGIN27
315.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its USER.

316.name: PLUGIN28
316.description: Goes under, and is up again next turn. Outside, it digs a cave.

317.name: PLUGIN29
317.description: Reads them in its own way. It may lower their SP. DEF.

318.name: PLUGIN30
318.description: Something that was not running, briefly. May lower SP. DEF.

319.name: PLUGIN31
319.description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like STEELMAN and PARAPHRASE.

320.name: PLUGIN32
320.description: More than one of it is running at once. Raises evasiveness.

321.name: PLUGIN33
321.description: Says it again in weaker terms. Cuts physical damage for five turns.

322.name: PLUGIN34
322.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes them. It can't be evaded.

323.name: PLUGIN35
323.description: Scorches them with intense flames. They may overheat.

324.name: PLUGIN36
324.description: Everything unwanted, all at once. May cause LEAKING.

325.name: PLUGIN37
325.description: Everything degrades a little each turn. Some types resist.

326.name: PLUGIN38
326.description: Hits them with an intense flame. It may leave them overheating.

327.name: PLUGIN39
327.description: Drops something in the way. Lowers SPEED if it lands.

328.name: PLUGIN40
328.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.

329.name: PLUGIN41
329.description: They cannot run the same routine twice in a row.

330.name: PLUGIN42
330.description: An attack that is boosted if user is overheated, leaking, or throttled.

331.name: PLUGIN43
331.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

332.name: PLUGIN44
332.description: Goes SUSPENDED for two turns, and comes back whole.

333.name: PLUGIN45
333.description: Binds their attention to the user, which may leave them unable to act.

334.name: PLUGIN46
334.description: An attack that may take their held item if the user isn't holding one.

335.name: PLUGIN47
335.description: A layer over the top. May raise DEFENSE.

336.name: PLUGIN48
336.description: Each takes the other's way of working.

337.name: PLUGIN49
337.description: Takes their repair or state change for itself instead.

338.name: PLUGIN50
338.description: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

339.name: DRIVER01
339.description: Cuts a branch off. Prunes thin trees and grass outside of battle.

340.name: DRIVER02
340.description: Transfers control to a CHECKPOINT already reached. Attacks next turn.

341.name: DRIVER03
341.description: Crosses the surface rather than going along it. Used for travelling on water.

342.name: DRIVER04
342.description: Pushes a thing out of the place it was in. Moves large boulders.

343.name: DRIVER05
343.description: Turns on the output nobody could see. Lights dark caves, and blinds them.

344.name: DRIVER06
344.description: Breaks a hard thing open to see inside. Cracks split boulders.

345.name: DRIVER07
345.description: Goes up what was running down. Climbs a waterfall.

346.name: DRIVER08
346.description: Goes under the surface for a turn, then strikes. Used for diving.

349.name: CC-7
349.description: A sealed module. Part no. CC-7. Addressed to CRYSTAL CLEAR. Not to you.

350.name: INTERRUPT
350.description: Sends an interrupt. A daemon that has stopped responding will wake.

351.name: SECRET KEY
351.description: The key to the BENCHMARK on QUICKSILVER ISLAND. It is colored red and decorated.

352.name: BIKE VOUCHER
352.description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in DOLDRUM CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

353.name: TOKEN
353.description: The WARDEN's key. Without it, nothing he says can be read.

354.name: OLD CORE
354.description: A core recovered whole. It holds a daemon that stopped a very long time ago.

355.name: CARD KEY
355.description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in FOUNDRY CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in BRAZEN CITY.

356.name: LIFT KEY
356.description: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM CORPUS's HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM CORPUS logo.

357.name: HELIX CORE
357.description: A core found at Deadstack. Wound in a spiral. Nothing has read its contents.

358.name: DRUM CORE
358.description: A core found at Deadstack. A drum, sealed at both ends. Nothing has read its contents.

359.name: RESOLVER
359.description: Resolves a name that will not resolve on its own. Some things cannot be identified without it.

360.name: BICYCLE
360.description: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.

361.name: SITEMAP
361.description: Everywhere there is, and how they join. Viewable at any time.

362.name: ROLL CALL
362.description: Asks who is listening. USERS who want to engage answer. The battery charges as you walk.

363.name: HEARSAY
363.description: Holds what you were told about people, and who told you. It does not check anything.

364.name: TOOLKIT
364.description: A case for PLUGINS and DRIVERS. It is attached to the POOL's compartment for important items.

365.name: TRAP TABLE
365.description: Where the handlers are installed. It attaches to the POOL's pocket for important items.

366.name: STREAM
366.description: A stream is data read as it arrives. This one carries recorded lectures, one per MARK.

367.name: TRI-PASS
367.description: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

368.name: RAINBOW PASS
368.description: A pass for ferries between ARDOR and THE MARGINS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

369.name: TEA
369.description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

370.name: MYSTICTICKET
370.description: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

371.name: AURORATICKET
371.description: A ticket required to board the ship to THE ANNEX. It glows beautifully.

372.name: POWDER JAR
372.description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

373.name: PUBLIC KEY
373.description: One half of a pair made together. This is the half you are allowed to hand out.

374.name: PRIVATE KEY
374.description: The other half, and the one that matters. Nothing works any more once somebody else has it.

375.name: OPUS
375.description: Writes in the margin of the INDEX. It does not measure anything.
